audience: practice administrators of clinics that run their messaging and phone lines on Spruce Health

useCases.title: List the staff and teams of the organization
useCases.text: The AI lists the organization's members with name, email, admin and suspended flags, and the members of one team. It shows who has access.

useCases.title: Review phone lines and channels
useCases.text: The AI lists the phone lines and the organization's own channels: Spruce phone and fax numbers, email addresses and Links, with owner and members.

useCases.title: Check the saved message templates
useCases.text: The AI lists saved message templates, private and organization-wide, with title, text and shared flags. You can find old or duplicate templates.

useCases.title: Review the tags and contact fields in use
useCases.text: The AI lists contact tags, conversation tags and the organization-wide contact fields. You see how the account is set up.

useCases.title: Confirm which organization is connected
useCases.text: The AI reads the organization's id and name, so you can check that the right account is linked.
